Hi Lara — great call today, thanks for walking through Acme's goals for the MAP POC. Per our discussion, I put together a short action summary and an initial MAP draft attached (redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf). High-level next steps: 

- We (Redwood) will provide a POC environment that mirrors our Dedicated network topology.

- Joint milestone: POC environment ready for smoke tests by 2026-07-09 (target).

2) SSO/SAML — target close: 2026-07-05

3) Secrets / KMS — target close: 2026-07-07

Dependencies: VPC peering approval, static egress IPs for allowlist, and IdP test user. See attached network-diagram.png for the topology we propose.

Can you confirm owners for VPC peering and SSO and whether Procurement needs to be looped for any MSA addendums? If dates look tight we can adjust the POC smoke test window.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min sync next week to align on owners.

Hi all — quick technical notes from the infra team to avoid rework when we request peering: 

1) VPC peering: we prefer a one-way peering where Redwood creates a peering connection from our VPC (redwood-poc-vpc) to Acme's VPC. Please provide the exact VPC ID and region. If Acme uses overlapping CIDRs we will instead use a transit/VPN approach — flag that early.

2) IP allowlist: we need the NAT egress IPs for the peer and an optional CIDR for backend callbacks. If Acme's egress IPs can change during the POC, consider allowing our test endpoints by hostname until static IPs are assigned.

3) SAML attributes: we'll need at minimum: NameID, email, and groups. If Acme uses an unfamiliar attribute name for groups, include a mapping table.

4) KMS/BYOK: for BYOK please share the key ARN and grant: kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey on the key to arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/RedwoodKMSAccess (we will provide the exact ARN).

Dev/infra will prepare the peering request template and sample Terraform snippet by EOD 2026-07-01.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
